mastery.task: Simulate repeated login attempts using a loop: stop at a correct password or lock after three failures. Test the third-attempt boundary.
mastery.hint: Keep a counter; check success and limit separately.
mastery.answer: Three failures -> Locked; two failures then correct -> success; counter increments only on failure. Never display the stored secret.
